text: dsh-audio-visualizer 是 DSH Web 界面插件，会挂载可拖动的悬浮频谱组件和全窗边缘光晕。点击组件后，用户可在屏幕共享选择器中允许系统音频，插件据此绘制 48 段彩虹频谱，并让低音驱动光晕变化；拖动可移动组件，位置保存在浏览器本地。无需 API 密钥或外部服务，适合想直观看到系统音频变化的 DSH 用户。

dsh-audio-visualizer adds a draggable spectrum chip and bass-driven glow to DSH Web. Clicking it captures user-selected system audio and draws a 48-band rainbow spectrum. The chip position is saved locally. No API key or external service is needed; the browser asks permission to share system audio.
想让 DSH 界面跟着电脑播放的声音显示动态频谱。
有没有办法在 DSH 窗口边缘加一个随低音变化的光效？
I want a draggable audio spectrum widget inside the DSH window.
dsh-audio-visualizer 的功能「系统音频频谱」：悬浮组件从用户授权的系统音频流读取频率数据，并绘制 48 段彩虹频谱。点击组件可启停，拖动可调整位置。
dsh-audio-visualizer 的功能「低音边缘光晕」：运行音频分析时汇总低频 FFT 数据，改变整个窗口内侧光晕的强度和色相；停止分析时清除光晕。
dsh-audio-visualizer 在浏览器内通过 AudioContext 分析用户选择的系统音频；代码路径仅建立本地分析节点，没有把音频发送到外部服务的实现。

dsh-audio-visualizer README · dsh-audio-visualizer：**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

System-audio driven UI visualizer for DeepSeek Harness (**dsh web** and **DSH Desktop**).

dsh-audio-visualizer README · dsh-audio-visualizer：- **Spectrum chip** — a draggable 118×24 floating chip drawing a 48-band rainbow spectrum that rides the system audio output in real time.
- **Frame glow** — the window gets a bass-driven inset glow (10–56 px spread, hue shifts with the low end).
- **Memory-only FFT** — audio is analysed with a Web Audio `AnalyserNode` and never leaves the process: nothing is recorded, stored, or uploaded.
- Click the chip to toggle. It remembers where you put it.

dsh-audio-visualizer README · How it works：`getDisplayMedia({ audio })` → drop the placeholder video track → `AnalyserNode` (fftSize 512, smoothing 0.5) → log-spaced 48-band mapping over the FFT bins → dynamic peak gain → canvas.

On **DSH Desktop** the Electron main process answers `getDisplayMedia` with `audio: 'loopback'` for every renderer session, so the visualizer starts with the app — no dialog, no clicks. That requires a one-time local patch (see below).

dsh-audio-visualizer README · Install：Available on npm: [`dsh-audio-visualizer`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-audio-visualizer) (or from Git: `git+https://github.com/caesarjue/dsh-audio-visualizer`).

dsh-audio-visualizer README · dsh web：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-audio-visualizer
```

Then click the chip and pick **Entire screen** + check **Share system audio** in the picker. The browser security model requires this manual opt-in every time; macOS Chrome/Chromium 141+ only.

dsh-audio-visualizer README · DSH Desktop：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-audio-visualizer
```

**Plus a one-time local patch** — the DSH Desktop Electron main process must answer `getDisplayMedia` with system-audio loopback. The patch script is bundled in `patch/`:

```sh
./patch/install-patch.sh   # backs up the app, patches main.js, re-signs, guides the macOS permission
```

See `patch/README.md` for the details (and rollback). After the patch the visualizer starts with the app, zero interaction.

dsh-audio-visualizer README · Requirements：- macOS 14.2+ (system-audio loopback via Core Audio taps); macOS permissions: **Screen Recording** + **Audio Capture** (grant in System Settings, then restart the app once)
- Chrome/Chromium 141+ for the web version
- DSH Desktop 2.0.5+ (Electron 43) tested; DSH web tested on dsh 0.1.5

dsh-audio-visualizer README · Files：- `package.json` / `cordis.patch.yml` / `lib/` — the plugin itself (`dsh.bundle` manifest declared)
- `patch/` — the optional DSH Desktop main-process patch (script + patch file + README)
